reviews.title: Really great build for the price and also 240 Hz. with great picture!
reviews.comment: One of the better Color quality pc monitors I have come across. Great value for your money because it has 240 Hz which can get you 240 fps if you have all the right components, and also have the right settings set. That said it also have G-Sync capabilities. And it also has display port and or hdmi ports. And the brightness is not too bright but not too dull. It is just right for me tbh.
reviews.author: Tyrus

reviews.title: Great monitor, finicky display port issues. Check that display port, pronto!
reviews.comment: I received this monitor after my veteran AOC 24SPG finally started to develop scan lines of doom. I tried this and an AOC Q27GSXMN - both are great monitors, but the combined eye strain of the Q27G due to my peculiar tastes lead me to keep this one. It lacks a clearly labeled gamma feature, which is actually under the shadow controls in gaming. The problem is my first monitor came with a finicky display port, that was randomly cutting out. After some troubleshooting and refunding came to mind, I discovered attaching another monitor to the graphics card would pull it out, but I strongly suspect that the port itself is the culprit. It works for now, but ordered replacement. After fixing that quagmire, the monitor took some time getting used to, but if your system supports brightness control, use it in tandem with shadows in the gaming menu. Pros - 240hz, ips, what else could you ask for? Even on HDMI, it's buttery smooth, and the color depth is amazing. It's great for gaming, some general design work. It's true quality is fast paced reaction times. Cons - It's ASUS, warranties are not just a battle, but a hill to die on. For the love of God, please including clearly labeled gamma features instead of combining features that confuse people!
reviews.author: Bob White

reviews.title: Screen refresh rate
reviews.comment: This gaming monitor is AWESOME! The screen refresh rate is excellent! It easily keeps up with the games that are played. It is not overly large but still gives a (POV) full point of view. The colors blend in perfectly with each other. Giving an enhanced view of Gaming performance.
reviews.author: M. Prince
